description: Immutable data available to stencil expression evaluation: the element's props, its size, the current repeat index, and the token resolver.

examples.title: Use StencilEvalContext

members.name: Props
members.description: The element's props, reachable as props.* inside an expression.

members.name: RepeatIndex
members.description: Zero-based index when the stencil part is repeated.

members.name: Tokens
members.description: Resolver used for token lookups; may be null.

members.name: Empty
members.description: An empty context with no props, zero size and no token resolver.

members.name: WithRepeatIndex
members.description: Returns a copy with a different repeat index; never throws.
